entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi... I'm a bit lost. I ordered this jersey and it just... it's not right. I don't really know what to do.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's a preference, I think? It's just the wrong size. It feels way too tight across my shoulders. I was looking on the website for how to return it, and it all seemed so complicated. Can't you just help me?

Of course, I can absolutely sort this out for you. It sounds like you'd like to do an exchange for a different size. Let me just pull up your order information... I see here that the jersey was delivered 11 days ago.
Yes, that sounds right. Is that okay? I thought I read something about ten days and I got worried I missed my chance.

No problem at all. According to our policy, standard items like your jersey are eligible for return for up to 90 days, so you are well within that timeframe. I can process this exchange for you right now.
Oh, 90 days? Phew! That's such a relief. Thank you so much. I was so confused.

You're very welcome. And I do see here that you're one of our VIP members. As a thank you for your loyalty, I've gone ahead and waived the return shipping fee, and I'll make sure your new, larger size ships out with complimentary expedited shipping.
Wow, that's really nice of you! You've made this so easy. Thank you, Sarah!
It's my pleasure. I've just emailed the prepaid return label to you. Simply pack the jersey and attach that label. Is there anything else I can do for you today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
Happy to assist. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
